correctness.rationale: All 4368 five-vertex subsets of Q4 were exhausted and checked by independent exact integer determinant algorithms; the coefficient polynomial and its factorization were verified. Boundaries and finite-versus-continuum roles are explicit.

value.rationale: The first open geometric Hypercube case admits a natural family of arbitrarily internally correlated fair bit pairs, beyond previously addressed radial-symmetric and independent-bit cases. Its complete exact 2-parameter profile, sharp constant, equality rigidity and monotonic response to correlations are mathematically motivated and nonroutine; this is not a claim for arbitrary weights.
